newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CHILLERS BUYS MASTER MEAT FOR 3.5 MLN RAND.
newsitem.headline: CHILLERS BUYS MASTER MEAT FOR 3.5 MLN RAND.

text.p: Chillers Group Ltd said on Tuesday its Dacman Holdings unit, which is in the process of changing its name to Chillers Food Services, had acquired Master Meat as a going concern for 3.50 million rand.

Chillers will settle the transaction by the issue of 2.19 million ordinary shares at 96 cents each, with the balance paid for by the issue if shares at 100 cents in various tranches up to December 1999.

At February 28, 1997, the net tangible assets of Master Meat -- which processes and distributes poultry and spareribs in Gauteng -- totalled 347,130 rand. The business earned a net profit of 577,093 rand in the year to February.
The acquisition is effective from March 1, 1997.
